title: WebMCP credential grant (A1 contract freeze, fixture-only)
description: WebMCP credential grant — A1 contract freeze (fixture-only). Digest uses RFC 8785 JCS, UTF-8, SHA-256 with domain label webmcp-digest-v1:grant and LF framing; protected projection excludes grantId/nonce/timestamps and digest. Synthetic IDs are prefixed lowercase hex (grant_ + 16 hex). D2/D3 provisional.

schema.description: Contract version; must be webmcp-credential-grant/1 in A1

grantId.description: Strict synthetic grant ID (grant_ + 16 lowercase hex). No real profile path or credential ID.

status.description: Grant lifecycle terminal states per capability-vault-runtime-broker. reconcile-required is local blocker, not success.

operation.description: Credential operation bound to grant. Direct-read is 'read' with scoped-values, not implicit from fill.

exposureMode.description: Exposure class. D2/D3 provisional: metadata-only vs scoped-values vs export are distinct grant types; no fallback.

purpose.description: Logical credential purpose; must be inside Store requirement and local binding intersection. Opaque kebab-case.

fields.description: Exact field set bound to grant. No wildcard, no implicit whole-item. D3: field names may be redacted in portable receipt per policy.

profileBindingId.description: Logical binding ID; not physical profile ID. Governor resolves to profileResourceId+leaseId+fenceEpoch.

siteOrigin.description: Absolute origin for login/browser grants; null for typed api_token/env/ssh_key when no origin policy (D7).

runClaimDigest.description: D1 provisional: JCS sha256 of live claim context; self-referential digest excluded.

bindingDigest.description: D1 provisional: JCS sha256 of resolved binding with domain label webmcp-digest-v1:binding; excludes raw path.

profileSessionDigest.description: D1 provisional: sha256 of profileResourceId+leaseId+fenceEpoch with label webmcp-digest-v1:fence; fenceDigest working name.

scopeDigest.description: Redacted scope digest; never secret-derived replayable value.

grantDigest.description: D1 provisional combined grant digest (optional in A1; grantDigest vs Vault lease extension under review).

maxUses.description: TTL/maxUses are suspicious signals; reclaim requires liveness check per Governor.

ttlMs.description: Optional TTL millis for debugging; expiresAt is authority.

nonce.description: Single-use nonce anti-replay; not persisted after use.

transcriptExposure.description: D2 provisional: denied unless host attests non-persistent channel or signed approval covers exposure.

channel.description: D2 provisional; host-provided ephemeral channel type, not persisted.

destinationDigest.description: For export only: digest of protected destination; not raw path.

id.description: Strict synthetic ID: prefixed lowercase hex with 16 hex chars (e.g., grant_deadbeef01234567).
